bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cd /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = a6a84876ab8ff9a81503ac15d1a3285e50634e1e
for c in debug-ai-sandbox-runner-1 debug-ai-debug-ai-1; do
  docker inspect --format '{{.Name}} running={{.State.Running}} health={{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}' "$c"
  if test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' "$c")" = true; then
    for p in server/workflow.js server/control/real-debug-benchmark.js server/adapters/external-review.js server/adapters/external-review-quota.js server/control/invocation-compiler.js server/control/role-output-validator.js; do
      if test "$(sha256sum "$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(docker exec "$c" sha256sum "/app/$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)"; then printf 'MATCH %s %s\n' "$c" "$p"; else printf 'MISMATCH %s %s\n' "$c" "$p"; fi
    done
  fi
done
